scopeGuardRules: Before adding a major dependency, subsystem, or capability: check its version_target classification.
FUTURE-V2 / FUTURE-V3 / FUTURE-UNASSIGNED: inspect, analyze, propose — never implement, migrate toward, or claim progress.
MIXED: implement only the V1 portion; the future portion stays frozen with its contract preserved.
UNKNOWN: stop the specific change, investigate evidence, classify before proceeding.
No agent may expand V1 scope silently (V5.3 Part 73). Un-freezing requires an explicit recorded human authorization decision.
Mixed classification claims must state which portion is V1; a claim without a version-target classification is unverified (V5.3 Part 75 law).
